summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned VSL landing page with clean white/light theme per Tab 5 guidelines. All features working correctly including animated counter, comparison block, 3-step cards, Bookafy calendar integration, and responsive design across all viewports.

minor_warnings.issue: New Relic warnings in console logs from external Bookafy service
minor_warnings.impact: Cosmetic console warnings only, calendar functionality works perfectly

passed_tests: VSL page loads at / route with clean white background (rgb(255,255,255))
Hero section with bold headline, video embed, and subtle grid pattern background
Big 97% stat section with animated counter (triggers on scroll, animates from 0% to 97%)
Comparison block displays 'What You See Today' vs 'What You Could See' correctly
3-step minimal cards (Install, Monitor, Reveal) render correctly in responsive grid
Alternating white/gray section backgrounds working (9 sections total)
Dark final CTA section with rgb(5,5,5) background
All 5 CTA buttons navigate correctly to /schedule route
FAQ accordion expands/collapses correctly (5 FAQ items tested)
Schedule page loads with proper layout and Bookafy calendar embed
Bookafy iframe loads from correct URL: https://websitetalkingheads.bookafy.com/schedule?type=iframe&locale=en
Back button navigates correctly from schedule to main page
Mobile responsive (390x844): video wrapper 358px, CTA buttons 329x60px, proper scaling
Tablet responsive (768x1024): 3-step cards 3-column grid, comparison 2-column grid
Desktop responsive (1920x1080): all layouts optimal, large stat counter display
Framer Motion animations working correctly throughout
Clean typography with Inter and Outfit fonts
Premium card styling and hover effects functional
